notes.title: Try to Wake Up : Update v 1.0.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44965006/35652cd48b03473f4e78427ddf1ec52b9793478c.png[/img]


Following feedback from players, a number of changes have been made to the game.

[u]Game update :[/u]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
- Fixed the bug that sometimes prevented the player from hiding the document containing the game rules.
- Added a visual to indicate which key to use to hide the document containing the game rules.

[b]Difficulty adjustment:[/b]
- Changed the anomalies in one of the rooms (they were very/too vicious)
- Removed the numbers on the doors in room 0.
- In ‘Normal’ mode it will now be indicated which room to start in, but only after reading the game rules document.
- The lights in the ‘red’ room have been readjusted to make it easier to see whether items are missing or not.


Thank you to the players for their valuable comments!
